Non-magical Roman legion heavy shield bearer, worn helmet and segmented iron torso plates, huge battered rectangular curved dark red shield with plain metal boss, short sword, leather sandals. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt: Original painted game character 2D sprite animation sheet on uniform vivid solid magenta #FF00FF background. Character identity, armor, and equipment strictly matching Reference-1.png: non-magical Roman legion heavy shield bearer wearing a worn iron helmet, segmented iron torso armor plates (lorica segmentata), pale undergarments, leather sandals, holding a huge battered rectangular curved dark red scutum shield with plain metal boss, and a short sword gladius. Art style strictly matching Reference-2.png: hand-painted digital dark fantasy, sculpted painterly volume, confident contours, silver highlights, worn dark metal, smooth opaque paint, cool upper-left lighting. Camera angle: elevated 55-degree orthographic view, front-right three-quarter perspective facing diagonally toward viewer and image right. Exactly a 4x4 grid of 16 distinct animation frames arranged in 4 equal rows and 4 equal columns with wide empty magenta gutters between cells. Each cell contains the entire full body at identical scale centered within the cell. No text, labels, border lines, grid lines, or background scenery. Row 1 (Quick flinch and recovery): frame 1 ready upright stance, frame 2 sharp backward recoil with shoulders and head snapped back and torso arched back 25 degrees, frame 3 recovering forward with bent braced legs, frame 4 upright recovered ready stance. Row 2 (Heavy stagger): frame 5 ready stance, frame 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body, frame 7 extreme backward stagger off-balance with arms pulled inward, frame 8 lower body absorbing impact with deeply bent knees. Row 3 (Stagger recovery and collapse start): frame 9 pushing back upright with effort, frame 10 recovered ready stance, frame 11 upright stance, frame 12 knees buckling and body dropping downward. Row 4 (Full collapse and defeat): frame 13 dropping very low toward ground, frame 14 torso falling sideways nearly horizontal, frame 15 body fully lying flat on side on ground with head and torso resting on ground, frame 16 completely motionless fully lying flat on ground on side with shield and sword resting beside body. All poses theatrical and harmless, intact armor, no gore.
